items.title: How does the size of an upfront information dump affect time-to-first-contribution?
items.description: The Scenario's new hire got all 40 pages on day 1, unanchored to any task, and still hadn't shipped anything by the two-week (~14 day) check-in. Drag the amount of context introduced at once to see how that scales — illustrating why a ramp plan hands over a small task first instead of the whole document.

params.name: pagesIntroducedAtOnce
params.label: Pages of context introduced before any task

items.compute: const daysToFirstContribution = Math.max(1, Math.round(params.pagesIntroducedAtOnce * 0.35)); return { daysToFirstContribution };

outputs.label: Days until first real contribution ships (illustrative)
